(3) He holds up a smartphone displaying a red-themed app interface with characters and gold coins, pointing at the screen with his other hand. (4) The camera zooms in to an extreme close-up of the man's eyes and nose as he stares intensely at the viewer with a furrowed brow. (6) Further cuts show food products including bottled oils and noodles in gift boxes, followed by an interface showing product lists and 'Buy Now' buttons. (8) The man returns to the screen in a medium shot, pointing at his eyes with two fingers, then back to his regular seated position gesturing emphatically. (9) The video ends with a repeat of the extreme close-up on his eyes, his expression appearing demanding and fixed on the camera.

The music maintains a constant high-energy rhythm. (3) A sequence of rapid 'click' and digital interface sounds overlays the narration as the speaker describes app features.
